device.description: 8-bit micropower voltage-output DAC with I2C interface and external reference
device.note: dac081c081.pdf (SNAS449F) p.4 (pin configuration and functions), p.6 (recommended operating conditions: VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs up to 5.5 V regardless of VA), p.11 (toutz 270 ns max fast mode), p.17 (power-on reset to 0), p.18 (power-down modes), p.19-21 (I2C protocol, Table 3 slave addresses, write Figure 25), p.22 (read Figure 26, DAC register Figure 27)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: D7-D0, bits 11-4 of the 16-bit DAC register (p.22 Figure 27); power-on zero (p.17)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: PD1 PD0, bits 13-12 of the DAC register: 00 normal, 01 2.5 kohm, 10 100 kohm, 11 Hi-Z

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: upper byte 0 0 PD1 PD0 D7-D4, lower byte D3-D0 x x x x; VOUT updates at the ACK after the lower byte; further byte pairs before STOP write again (p.21 Figure 25)

pages: p.4 (pin configuration and functions), p.6 (recommended operating conditions: VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs up to 5.5 V regardless of VA), p.11 (toutz 270 ns max fast mode), p.17 (power-on reset to 0), p.18 (power-down modes), p.19-21 (I2C protocol, Table 3 slave addresses, write Figure 25), p.22 (read Figure 26, DAC register Figure 27)
notModeled: VOUT, VREF and the resistor-string output (analog); the power-down output terminations (2.5 kohm / 100 kohm / Hi-Z) are stored in CTRL.PD only
ADR0/ADR1 left floating (or at VA/2) select further addresses (Table 3): a third strap level cannot be expressed, only GND and VA are in the table
broadcast address 1001000 (0x48): every DAC081C081/C085 responds and updates together; only the strap address is modeled
address lock: ADR0/ADR1 are sampled only until the first correctly addressed non-broadcast access, then the address is fixed until power cycling (the model re-reads the straps)
Hs-mode master code (00001xxx) handshake (the bus engine handles I2C timing)
the 'Do Not Use' addresses of Table 3 note 2
wake-up time from power-down (0.5-0.8 us typ)
read-back bits 3-0 below D0: shown as 0 (Figure 27 shows 0 0 0 0)
VREF reference input 1 V to VA (analog)
variants: DAC081C081 (SOT-6 / WSON-6): one strap ADR0, VA is the reference; same register and protocol.
